description: Limitation pin (016 T014r, plan D11 as amended after round 9; round-9 review F1, d05). A paragraph door: the indented <?x continues the paragraph (indented code cannot interrupt one), so CommonMark has no processing instruction there and starts a div block at <div> that runs to the blank line. The container regex strips the indentation, so the tracker opens a PI block at <?x and ignores the div until ?>; on its end x <!--, a line of CommonMark's div block, is read as inline text with no closer before the blank line and disarmed; the marker is harvested and the digest that carries only the visible rule is read as stale. Both renderers (markdown-it, commonmark.js) hide the marker in a real comment, as the parent e10da18 does. This is FR-003's exception as amended after round 9 (a long-end span the tracker holds and CommonMark does not). If the mechanism is ever modelled, the digest check passes, so this case fails and must be retired or turned into a guard.
